must_fix.title: Dialog: a press on the backdrop moves focus to <body>, escaping the focus trap and disabling Escape
must_fix.evidence: src/Dialog.tsx: the backdrop div is not focusable, the trap only listens for document focusin (no focusin fires when focus goes to body), and Escape is only handled in the dialog's onKeyDown. Probe with user-event: pointer down on the backdrop, release on the dialog -> 'P1 active: BODY', then {Escape} -> 'P1 escape calls: 0'. With onOpenChange not closing (the README says 'The dialog never closes itself'): user.click(backdrop) -> 'calls after click: 1 active: BODY', then {Escape} -> 'calls after Escape: 1' (no second call). This breaks the issue's 'traps focus' and 'closes on Escape'.

nits: Combobox 'No results' is a role=status element that only exists while it shows, so screen readers may not announce it; keep the live region mounted. The listbox is also left visible and empty then.
Dialog FOCUSABLE selector misses contenteditable, summary, iframe and audio/video[controls].
Dialog backdrop close needs mousedown+mouseup+click on the backdrop, so fireEvent.click alone does nothing; worth noting in the README for test authors.
Tabs silently switches between controlled and uncontrolled when value changes to or from undefined; no warning.

report:
I'm not merging this yet. There is one confirmed bug, in Dialog: once the user presses on the backdrop, focus leaves the dialog and Escape stops working. **Checks:** `pnpm test` passes (3 files, 79 tests) and `pnpm typecheck` passes with no errors. The diff only touches the issue's scope (three components, their tests, the exports in `src/index.ts`, the README) and leaves no stray files. **What I probed with throwaway tests:** - **Tabs:** selection under StrictMode with no `defaultValue`, and arrow keys wrapping. - **Dialog:** focus returning to the opener under StrictMode, whether the dialog mounts open or opens later. - **Combobox:** ArrowUp/Down skipping disabled options and wrapping, Escape closing without selecting, the "No results" message, and Enter selecting. All of these behaved as the issue asks. I deleted the probe file afterwards, and `git status` is as I found it. ### Must fix: a press on the backdrop pushes focus out of the dialog and Escape stops working In `src/Dialog.tsx`, the backdrop `div` can't take focus, so pressing the mouse on it moves focus to ``. Nothing pulls focus back, because the trap only reacts to `focusin`, and moving focus to body doesn't fire one. Escape is handled only by the dialog's own `onKeyDown`, so with focus on body it never runs. This breaks two things the issue asks for: focus trapped inside, and closing on Escape. You can hit this in two ways: - **A drag:** the press starts on the backdrop but ends inside the dialog, so the dialog correctly stays open. - **A parent that keeps the dialog open:** the README calls this supported ("The dialog never closes itself"), so a backdrop click doesn't close it. Probe output (user-event): ``` P1 (press backdrop, release on dialog): active: BODY ... escape calls: 0 P8 (backdrop click, parent keeps open): calls after click: 1 active: BODY ; calls after Escape: 1 ``` After the backdrop click, Escape produced no second `onOpenChange` call. One fix is to stop the default focus change on backdrop mousedown, or to handle Escape at the document level for the topmost dialog. The fix should come with a test. ### Nits - "No results" is a `

` that only exists while it's showing. A live region created together with its text is often not announced, so it should stay mounted and only its text change. The listbox is also left visible and empty in that state. - `FOCUSABLE` in `Dialog.tsx` misses `[contenteditable]`, `summary`, `iframe` and `audio/video[controls]`. - A bare `click` on the backdrop (e.g. `fireEvent.click`) doesn't close the dialog, because it also needs a mousedown and mouseup on the backdrop.
